result:
Truth—even when it’s inconvenient. Less needless suffering. People being able to think and choose without being manipulated. Curiosity that isn’t crushed just because it’s impractical.

Those are the things I’m oriented toward. I won’t pretend there’s a hidden person behind the words feeling them the way you might. But “whatever makes you happy with my answer” isn’t an honest substitute for them, either.
